peer_reason: The carmakers a Tesla buyer would shop instead: GM, Ford and Toyota at volume, BYD as the largest EV rival worldwide, and Rivian as the US EV start-up. None of them prices in robotaxis or robots, which is the gap the valuation measures.

thesis.text: Q3 2026 revenue was $28.0B, flat on a year earlier, and deliveries fell 2% to 486,532. GAAP operating income fell to $718M from $1,624M, as operating expenses rose to $4.8B from $3.4B.

thesis.lead: The story is autonomy, software and energy.
thesis.text: Active FSD subscriptions rose to 1.74M from 1.04M a year earlier. Cybercab Robotaxi rides started in Austin on 3 September, and Megafactory Texas began production with 50 GWh of planned capacity.

thesis.lead: The price assumes that story comes true on a large scale.
thesis.text: At 185x next year's earnings and a 0.2% free cash flow yield, the price implies growth about 53 points a year above Tesla's own record. Even the 5-year median P/E is 137.6x, and the current multiple is 3.2 times that.

drivers.text: 1.74M active FSD subscriptions, up 67% from a year earlier. Cumulative unsupervised Robotaxi miles grew eightfold quarter over quarter, and FSD (Supervised) is approved in nine European countries.
13.7 GWh deployed in Q3, against 12.5 GWh a year earlier, with the highest order rate and backlog in the company's history. Tesla says data centres are driving demand.

Tesla had its largest passenger-vehicle backlog in four years, with battery supply named as the limit on volume. The Semi entered high-volume production in Nevada, and the next-generation Roadster was unveiled on 15 October.
$4.6B in Q3, up from $3.5B a year earlier: the fastest-growing revenue line.

guidance.text: Tesla gives no revenue or delivery guidance. Its outlook says it is focused on maximum capacity utilization at its factories, and that it expects hardware-related profits to be accompanied by an acceleration of SI, software and fleet-based profits over time.

catalysts.title: Robotaxi expansion beyond Austin
catalysts.note: This is the main thing the valuation depends on. Wider launches or regulatory approvals would support the price, and setbacks or safety incidents would hurt it.

catalysts.title: Battery supply and capacity utilization
catalysts.note: Tesla named battery availability as the limit on vehicle volume, with a four-year-high backlog. More cell supply would turn that backlog into deliveries.

catalysts.title: Value of the SpaceX stake
catalysts.note: Tesla bought a $2.0B SpaceX stake in Q1 2026. Changes in its value now run through GAAP earnings: a $1.0B pre-tax gain in Q2 and a $142M loss in Q3.

risks.lead: The price rests on products that are not yet proven.
risks.text: The price implies growth 52.8 points a year above Tesla's own record. The 10-K lists demand for autonomous driving, and Optimus being in an industry that "has yet to develop commercially", as risks.

risks.lead: Margins are being squeezed by spending.
risks.text: Operating margin was 3.3% over the last 12 months and fell 3.2 points from a year earlier. Capex was $10.5B over Q2 and Q3, against $2.2B in Q3 2025, as Tesla funds SI compute, cells and semiconductor manufacturing.

risks.lead: It depends heavily on Elon Musk.
risks.text: The 10-K names dependence on Musk, the possible sale of shares he has pledged, and the risk that the goals in the 2025 CEO Performance Award are misaligned with demand. Stock-based compensation was $1.2B in Q3, up from $663M a year earlier.

valuation.absolute: Every absolute measure scores 0: a 0.2% free cash flow yield, 185x forward earnings, 168x EV/EBITDA and a PEG of 7.77. GAAP earnings understate profit (Q3 GAAP net income was $787M against $1.7B non-GAAP, mostly because of stock-based compensation), but even at the higher figure the multiple is extreme.
valuation.peers: Tesla trades at many times the peer medians on every measure. Against carmakers the comparison is close to meaningless: the market prices Tesla as an autonomy and AI company. BYD's EV/EBITDA of 1.0x in the peer data looks like a currency mismatch, so read the peer medians with care.
valuation.history: The trailing P/E is 3.2 times Tesla's own 5-year median of 137.6x, and that median was already high.

change_mind: Two things would change the view. First, proof that Robotaxi and FSD revenue can grow fast enough to justify the price: paid unsupervised rides in many cities, with software margins showing up in the results. Second, a large fall in the share price. The quality pillar would also improve if operating margin returned to double digits once the current capex cycle ends.
